title: 8 PCS Reusable Cheesecloth, Grade 100, 20x20 Inch Hemmed Cheese Cloth for Straining Craft, 100% Cotton Unbleached Cloth Strainer for Cooking, Baking, Juicing, Cheese Making (40×50 Threads)
description:
About this item
Precuted & Well Hemmed -- Cheese cloths is precuted 20* 20 inch shape. No need to cut by yourself. And each cheesecloth edge is precisely sewn which won’t burst or leave small threads in food.
Material -- Cheese cloth is made of 100% unbleached organic cotton which is safe and healthy. It will never leave color on cheese, yogurt, turkey or any other foods.
Easy to Clean and Reusable -- Cheesecloth is simple to clean and can be reused multiple times after washing, making it a cost-effective option for various kitchen and craft tasks.
Grade 100 -- The cheesecloth is the highest grade with ultra fine mesh which woven with 40×50 threads per inch. It can filter more impurities and work efficiently. Won't tear easily.
Multi-function -- Cheesecloth can be used in different household and professional applications. It could be used for making homemade cheese, Greek yogurt, butter, almond milk, nut milk, fruit juice, spice bags, canning, kombucha.

Works every time.Very clean, works well for tofuCan do a lot of things very strong,very big.For years, I've used the cheap and 1-use cheesecloth for cooking needs that I could find and buy at the local grocery store. But in recent years, I found it harder and harder to find. I use it primarily for when I make broths and stocks and have tried numerous ways to make it "finer" to block more of the debris that can cloud a good stock. I've also started composting now that my city offers composting bins for those of us living in multi-unit buildings without access to a yard/location to place our own composting bin. All that drove me to Amazon to find these AMAZING re-usable cheesecloths! I've just used one for 2 batches of stock I've made before and after the Thanksgiving holiday and washed it with PERFECT results! I even handed along the 3 other cloths in this pack to my niece, sister-in-law and friend who had been looking for a quality cheesecloth like this as well. I highly recommend and expect to be using this for years to come.
